scope: Actual delivery screening; no new evaluation framework, model benchmark or stable Skill change. Self-review is not independent review.
partition_check: 18 + 10 + 1 + 2 + 9 + 2 + 6 = 48. Six remaining are not counted as fully screened or Owner-OK.

exact_level1_supplement.execution: Each template actually queried separately for each listed name. Conovant/Mosaicary had these intents queried in SCREEN-01; raw bare-exact queries for all candidates also retained there.
exact_level1_supplement.result: No substantiated exact organization/software/trademark identity for these seven appeared in the retrieved results. Several searches returned ordinary phrase usage, unrelated fallback results or excerpts rather than exact records. This is not a claim of zero registry records.

near_queries: "AnOpenSelf" OR "An Open-Self" OR "Open Self" company trademark
"PluralAccord" OR "Plural Accords" OR "Plural Accord" brand trademark

near_findings.name: An Open Self
near_findings.observation: OpenSelf is actively used for AI personal-identity products/projects; removing the non-distinctive article leaves the same verbal core. The psychology practice provides an additional different-sector use. No need to infer a registered trademark to stop this candidate's current delivery path.
near_findings.assessment: Controller identity-risk judgment; not a declaration of infringement.

near_findings.name: Conovant
near_findings.observation: Covant is actively used in software. Conovant has an extra syllable/letters, so it is not an exact match; nevertheless the remaining similar frame in overlapping software scope requires more than a clean .com observation.
near_findings.assessment: Do not automatically declare a legal conflict or let unsupported reassurance promote it to the exposure batch.

near_findings.name: Mosaicary
near_findings.observation: MosaicRY-3D is an active creative/GIS-derived physical-map identity. Mosaicary differs, but the near spelling, potential reduced pronunciations and overlapping creation/knowledge context require a closer check.
near_findings.assessment: Not an exact collision or automatic proof of legal bar; hold, not a new Owner dislike or ban on mosaic-derived words.

near_findings.name: Once Anew
near_findings.observation: Once Anew appears as a track title on Das Birthday Girl's 2024 album Soft and Clear. A work title is not itself proof of an identically named company or trademark; publication/creative-scope risk stays explicitly recorded rather than treating it as unseen.
near_findings.assessment: Retain internally pending the final commercial-risk decision; no song lyrics copied.

near_findings.name: Plural Accord
near_findings.observation: An official TTAB result mentioned PLURAL, including serial 97922847, not PLURAL ACCORD. A component word is neither evidence of exact absence nor an automatic ban on the composite name.
near_findings.assessment: Do not substitute the bare word's docket for a complete candidate-level search or assert the proceedings' current legal outcome.

near_findings.name: Common Latitude
near_findings.observation: Common latitude/common latitudes occurs in geodetic research; Latitude is also an active map-design studio. Neither observation alone proves an exact COMMON LATITUDE organization, but geographical descriptiveness and the shared LATITUDE element are recorded for risk review.
near_findings.assessment: Do not present it as an invented term or assume geographic services would have the same distinctiveness outlook as the broad umbrella role.

public_jurisdiction_trademark_queries.execution: All four jurisdiction-oriented public-web queries actually executed per listed candidate; 36 searches. Conovant/Mosaicary used 'trademark USPTO' and 'trademark EUIPO TMview' order but same tokens.

official_domain_index_supplement.result: No exact candidate-level trademark hit substantiated; an official PLURAL component docket and unrelated legislative pages appeared.

public_jurisdiction_trademark_queries.bounded_result: No material exact candidate mark was substantiated in retrieved public-web pages. Empty or unrelated responses do not establish registry absence; there is no count of marks examined or official negative-result receipt.
public_jurisdiction_trademark_queries.readiness_rule: Public query execution is recorded as done, but is not silently upgraded to all-jurisdiction commercial clearance or 'good registration outlook'. No full-screen pass claimed while this remains unresolved.
public_jurisdiction_trademark_queries.prior_scope: Prior POLICY70 called for public preliminary risk screening, not formal legal clearance. We are not adding a guarantee of registration; the issue is having a defensible candidate-level check rather than calling unrelated search results a completed negative search.

intrinsic_and_language_review.scope: English spelling/likely readings and Chinese-speaker use burden; no invented etymology, standardized human listening tests or worldwide linguistic clearance.

rows.name: Plural Accord
rows.intrinsic: shared agreement can coexist with different views; does not need to mean identical thought
rows.language: two ordinary-word units; pl/r/l sounds add Chinese pronunciation burden, but no number-of-syllables hard failure
rows.visual: initial tall group in Plural, broader low run in Accord and a tall final d; some internal rises, not a flat silhouette
rows.distinctiveness: composite potentially suggestive for an umbrella; PLURAL component and conflict-resolution services need careful scope review

rows.name: Common Latitude
rows.intrinsic: shared setting with individual latitude; geographical metaphor does not itself limit all projects
rows.language: ordinary word boundaries; longer than compact coinages, considered a tradeoff not a hard failure
rows.visual: Common has a low middle; Latitude contains more alternating tall strokes; soft rhythm disadvantage recorded
rows.distinctiveness: known geographic wording can be descriptive for geodetic teaching/tools; broader umbrella use must be assessed separately

rows.name: All Yet Each
rows.intrinsic: compact contrast between collective belonging and individual perspective
rows.language: three short units; may sound like a statement rather than a traditional corporate name, which is a tradeoff not automatic rejection
rows.visual: three short blocks; tall strokes cluster at the beginning and ends rather than filling a long oscillating word
rows.distinctiveness: slogan-like structure could require source-distinctiveness analysis; no automatic registrability claim from the wordplay

rows.name: Once Anew
rows.intrinsic: renewed interpretations/creation from prior material; naturally broad rather than product-specific
rows.language: ordinary spelling; once may initially puzzle some learners but no special prescribed respelling needed
rows.visual: two smooth low runs after the initial capitals; few ascender interruptions in the rendered fonts
rows.distinctiveness: phrase suggests renewal; existing song title recorded, not ignored or converted to legal certainty

rows.name: Ongoing Ground
rows.intrinsic: stable common foundation that is continually revised through contribution
rows.language: clear two-word segmentation; ng/gr transition is a moderate articulation burden; no listening experiment claimed
rows.visual: three g descenders cluster in Ongoing plus the start of Ground; more lower-contour movement than some alternatives
rows.distinctiveness: not an obvious literal label for broad research/software/publishing, but ground-related services would change the analysis

rows.name: Untold Measure
rows.intrinsic: unexpressed perspectives and value beyond one fixed measure; research and creation both remain possible
rows.language: two ordinary words; voiced zh in measure and untold's closing cluster may be harder for Chinese speakers
rows.visual: Untold has several tall strokes; Measure forms a relatively calm lower run after M, so the whole is not uniformly jagged
rows.distinctiveness: interpretive rather than a direct service list; a measurement-only product use would need separate scope consideration

rows.name: An Open Self
rows.intrinsic: previously retained for independent/openness relation; later reality failure does not rewrite that judgment
rows.language: ordinary word units, psychology emphasis remains a tradeoff
rows.visual: three separate word blocks with some p/f/l extension

rows.name: Conovant
rows.intrinsic: constructed identity with declared creation/shared-work intention; not a verified historical word
rows.language: multiple plausible stress/vowel choices, proposed reading not established by user testing
rows.visual: comparatively low uniform middle, with capital C and terminal t rising

rows.name: Mosaicary
rows.intrinsic: mosaic-like plurality/creation metaphor; not proof that every individual's agency is encoded
rows.language: mosaic plus ary can yield different syllable boundaries; original proposed five-syllable reading remains an intention
rows.visual: mostly lower-height middle with final y descender; no visual hard failure declared

visual_execution.method: Pillow rendered nine retained display spellings in DejaVu Sans and Liberation Serif, 48px; image opened and inspected by Controller
visual_execution.evidence_preserved_here: font names, size, case convention and written observations; original image is a session attachment, not promised as a permanent repository file
visual_execution.scope: soft aesthetic observations only, no quantified peak threshold or proof of Owner preference

freshness_queries.result: No new substantiated exact entity in the retrieved recency-filtered set; this does not substitute for the unfiltered searches or establish complete index coverage.
freshness_queries.registrar_refresh: Not repeated in this stage because no Owner exposure is occurring. Earlier same-session registrar receipt preserved in SCREEN-01; refresh again immediately before actual consolidated exposure.

batch_diversity_observation: All six are phrase-form survivors. That is an observed filtering outcome, not a new Owner preference for phrases. Do not clone their words or discard otherwise qualifying names solely to force a score; next generation should add materially different compact name forms through the existing portfolio.
blocker_for_full_pass: Reliable candidate-level trademark screening coverage remains unestablished with current read-only web access. The six retained records therefore stay internal, not a cleared aesthetic-review packet. An interactive browser/search source is needed to resolve this without transferring raw-name selection to Owner.
